title: The Cockpit
caption: Dusk over Patagonia. Below, the windows are lighting up.

storm.means: the storm: 0 — none (the dusk over the steppe), 1 — in the storm: black-violet cloud all round, rain driven past, lightning (with above 1 — the storm is below, flickering in the cloud sea)

rain.means: the rain driven past the plane: 0 none … 1 the storm's downpour (with storm 1 inside it; 0 again once the plane is over the clouds)

above.means: over the clouds: 0 — no, 1 — the plane has climbed out of the storm into the clear night: stars overhead, the sea of cloud white under the moon below

flash.means: the lightning's light now (set by the scene's script while storm is 1): 0 dark, 1 the flash

panel.means: the lamps in the cockpits — the instrument lamp before Fabien, lighting his face from below, and the radio's small lamp before the operator: 0 off, 1 lit

bob.means: the height of the plane's anchor (Fabien's seat) in the air, metres: 1.6 where it flies, a little more risen, less sunk — moved by the scene's script: a slow few centimetres at dusk and over the clouds, jolts in the storm

night.means: the night over the steppe (with storm 0 and above 0): 0 — the dusk; 1 — eleven o'clock, a starry night, the steppe black, the lights of Trelew below ahead; the light's look `night`

gap.means: in the storm (storm 1, above 0): a gap in the cloud overhead with stars in it — 0 closed, 1 open; a little starlight comes down through it

roll.means: the plane laid on a wing, degrees (the anchor `plane` tilted, the seated people with it): 0 level; ± its top toward or away from the viewer — a little in the storm's jolts, ~60 when it is thrown on a wing (М5 lost)

water.means: in the storm: the sea glimpsed far below through a rent in the cloud as the plane is laid on a wing — seen as the lightning lights it: 0 none, 1 there

climb.means: the climb out of the storm (М6): 0 not begun … 1 at the top — the nose raised as it goes (`pitch`, the scene's script) and level again at the top, the cloud masses sinking past, the gap overhead opening wider, its light growing; at 1 the piece `above` begins (above 1)

pitch.means: the plane's nose, degrees (the anchor `plane` turned in its own face — its `roll` — about Fabien's seat, everything on the plane with it): 0 level, − the nose up, + down; set by the scene's script from `climb`

house.means: at dusk: the lone house's window below the plane — 0 dark, 1 lit

beat_next.means: the piece the game plays next (modules/beats: made ready ahead)

objects.name: The sky and what lies below

Fabien's plane: the anchor its parts and its people are on, at Fabien's seat (the plane turns about it) — rising and sinking a little (`bob`), its nose raised or dropped (`pitch`: turned in its own face), laid on a wing (`roll`: tilted about its length)
The parasol wing over the front cockpit
The top of the fuselage, the cockpits cut through it

prompts.text: bowed vibraphone and reverb, cold blue air over the clouds, stars, stillness
sustained strings, wide and calm, dusk over Patagonia, the lights coming on below
slow solo piano, sparse chords, nocturnal, restrained and dignified, French impressionist colour
distant morse telegraph clicks over a low string drone, tense and patient, night office
low strings sustained, slow, grave and tender, a long night of waiting
muted trumpet far away, a few long notes, lonely airfield at night
ambient engine hum, low propeller drone, airy pad, vast night sky
string quartet adagio, grave, restrained, noble sadness
celesta and harp, stars over clouds, weightless and cold
deep timpani rolls and low brass, a storm gathering far off
solo cello, long bowed notes, bitter and beautiful
minimalist piano ostinato, clockwork pulse, waiting for news
clarinet and bassoon, quiet and dry, an office at midnight
wordless choir very soft, high and far, moonlit sea of clouds
slow waltz on a small orchestra, faded, a lamp in a window
bowed vibraphone and reverb, cold blue air, stillness
orchestral swell, heroic yet sorrowful, dawn after a lost night
low horn chorale, slow, mourning without tears
